notes.title: New demo version available now
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218251/2bf3fdb1df122f1e59f6c837a385ba865d539b8e.jpg"][/img][b]What's new in this demo:
[/b]
- Name changed to "Fruit vs. Aliens".
- 16 waves of enemies from two stages to fight.
- New art style for enemy units.
- New spell system with 5 spell types.
- 10 fruit units to mix and match.
- a little bit of "Roguelike" with random enemy placement, cards, etc.

Any feedback is welcome. Please post it on Discussions.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261090/Fruit_vs_Aliens_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
